newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Entertainment in merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Entertainment in merger deal.

text.p: Retail store operator Trans World Entertainment Corp said on Monday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire substantially all the assets of Strawberries Inc, a privately held retailer of pre-recorded music and video.
The agreement's terms were not disclosed.
In a statement, Trans World said Strawberries operates 118 locations, most of them in New England and Washington D.C.

"The acquisition of Strawberries, with its concentrated non-mall store format, offers Trans World additional opportunities to add value to our existing protfolio of stores, enhance overall operating performance and further strengthen our position within the industry," said Trans World chief executive Robert Higgins.
